plan.title: Scholarship Applicants Overview
plan.subtitle: Key metrics and insights on applicant status, marks, income, and distribution across talukas

panels.title: Total Applicants
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM scholarship_applicants

panels.title: Approved Applicants
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM scholarship_applicants WHERE "Status"='Approved'

panels.title: Average Marks
panels.sql: SELECT AVG("Marks %") AS avg_marks FROM scholarship_applicants

panels.title: Average Family Income
panels.sql: SELECT AVG("Family Income") AS avg_income FROM scholarship_applicants

panels.title: Status Distribution
panels.sql: SELECT "Status" AS status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM scholarship_applicants GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Average Marks by Category
panels.sql: SELECT "Category" AS category, AVG("Marks %") AS avg_marks FROM scholarship_applicants GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Top 10 Highest Marks
panels.sql: SELECT "Sr No" AS sr_no, "Naam" AS name, "Marks %" AS marks, "Family Income" AS income, "Taluka" AS taluka, "Status" AS status FROM scholarship_applicants ORDER BY "Marks %" DESC LIMIT 10

plan.narrative: The dashboard provides a concise view of the scholarship applicant pool. The first four KPIs show the overall size of the applicant base, the number of approvals, the average academic performance, and the average family income, giving a quick snapshot of the demographic and academic profile. The bar chart on status distribution highlights how many applicants are in each stage of the process, helping to identify bottlenecks or areas needing attention. The second bar chart breaks down average marks by category, revealing which groups are performing best academically. Finally, the table lists the top 10 applicants by marks, allowing stakeholders to quickly spot high performers and their associated talukas and statuses. All numeric values are represented by placeholders such as {{p1.n}}, {{p2.n}}, {{p3.avg_marks}}, {{p4.avg_income}}, {{p5.count}}, {{p6.avg_marks}}, and {{p7.marks}} to keep the data dynamic and up‑to‑date.
